title: Early Bird Delegate Registrations Open
body: Early bird registrations for GIMUN and GMC are officially open. Priority committee allocations will be awarded to delegations submitting prior to October 15.

title: Official Moot Court Proposition Released
body: The problem proposition covering International Cyber Sovereignty & Transboundary Jurisdiction is now accessible in the Resource Hub.

title: GIMUN Rules of Procedure Handbook Updated
body: The 2027 revision of the GIMUN RoP document has been updated with clarified crisis committee flow and working paper submission formatting.
